episodes.title: Finder’s Cult: You Won’t Believe the Connections
episodes.description:
In this video, we take a closer look at the Finders — the mysterious group that became the subject of a major controversy in the 1980s.

Who were the Finders? What happened to the group and the children involved in the investigation? Why did the case attract attention from law enforcement and the media, and what evidence exists about what actually happened?

We’ll go through the history of the Finders case, the allegations, the investigation, and the questions that still surround the story today. We’ll separate documented facts from rumors and speculation so you can make up your own mind about this unusual and controversial case.

⚠️ This video discusses allegations involving child abuse, trafficking, and other disturbing subjects. Viewer discretion is advised.

If you enjoy investigations into mysterious organizations, unexplained cases, and controversial moments in history, subscribe for more.
